summary: The kernel is one-thread-per-row with an explicit row<dim guard and complete rowDelimiters[row]..rowDelimiters[row+1] accumulation/store. Host spmvGpu computes ceil(dim/256) blocks, caps the grid at 65535, and the main loop invokes it iterations times before stream/device synchronization. The compiled timed main, spmvGpu helper and actual device stub to cudaLaunchKernel were inspected. The binary contains the same kernel for sm_50, 60, 61, 70, 75, 80 and 86; all seven native SASS bodies were inspected through row bounds, nonzero loops and stores.
